resources.string: Exact app detection for reminders and blocks

Quiet uses this to know which app is open, to close short-video feeds you turned off, to keep websites of blocked apps closed, and to lock the screen on a double tap. What it reads stays on this phone and is not kept.
Lets Quiet lock the screen on a double tap. It can do nothing else.
Quiet only uses this to lock the screen when you double-tap Home. Android will ask for your PIN at the next unlock instead of your fingerprint. Turn it off in Quiet before uninstalling.
Keeps reminders, pauses and blocks running
